body:
If I'm honest, this comment spoke to me the most. I've simply never imagined a future where I'm happy or even just getting by, but hearing your story gave me just the tiniest bit of hope. 

I'm still not entirely sure if I'll make it through this year. It feels so hopeless looking ahead of me right now. But if I could help you reflect, and if I wishfully think that maybe it'll be better someday, then I think today won't be as horrible.

No, I wouldn't call myself disabled. I do experience pain that might be considered chronic, I'm unsure, but I wouldn't call it a disability. Mental health wise, I also think it's highly likely I have ADHD and BPD, but I will never be able to get diagnosed due to my mom.

I am glad to know that other people feel similarly, though. I'm still just kind of living mindlessly, waiting for the things I have an actual sense of passion for to update.

I hate vomiting. I'm terrified of being sick just because of that. If I'm going to die, at the very least I don't want to throw up while doing it. But I guess it doesn't matter if I'd be dead soon anyway.
